differences: The README says conditions differ from 150 gait cycles by less than 10, but one participant (the sixth file) has 135, 135, 139 and 124 and 122 cycles in five conditions (the rigid block 124 and 122 after the 150 warm-up cycles); all other conditions are within 9 of 150. All cycles are kept.

The Methods give mean body mass 68.4 +- 12.2 kg and height SD 6.8 cm, but the paper's own Table 1 (used here for age, sex and the participants file) averages 72.0 +- 10.5 kg and 172.4 +- 6.7 cm; mean age (27.05, printed 27.1) and mean height (172.4) agree, so mass is not used as a check.

The deposit's README (and the figshare description) lists the speeds as 0.8, 1 and 1.2 m/s, but the files hold speed0p6, speed0p8 and speed1p0, matching the paper's 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0 m/s; the paper's values are used.
The right-leg gait-event lists in the deposit are copies of the left-leg ones, so right-leg timing is not released.
